payload.reason: The evidence indicates a correlation between daytime activity and socioeconomic status (SEC), suggesting that people active during the day tend to have higher SEC and use more standard language.

claims.text: People active during the day have higher average income than those active at night, indicating a link between daytime activity and socioeconomic status.
Individuals tweeting during the day use a more standard language compared to those active at night, which is associated with higher socioeconomic status.
